card.name: Words just before seizure terms
card.fires_on: Linking words and verbs such as "of", "treat", "induce" or "prevent" that come right before an expected word like seizures or status epilepticus. It appears in drug-label text about convulsions.

modes.label: Verb or "of" before seizures
modes.description: A verb or the word "of" after treatment or induction, where seizures or status epilepticus comes next.
modes.example: For the treatment<< of>> status epilepticus, the usual recommended

modes.label: Other lead-ins in seizure text
modes.description: A number gap or "such" in a seizure or overdose passage, just before a following term.

card.writes: It pushes toward the next word being a seizure-related term, though the promoted tokens look mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before "seizures" or "status epilepticus" is expected.
